purpose: Second and final declared study: slower horizon and crypto directional asymmetry. Keep study 1 failures. 2024/2025 are already observed diagnostics, only 2026 is a fresh holdout. No subsequent tuning.
dataAmendment: Keep study 1 data completeness policy and calendar cuts. Add complete official January–August 2026 archives for the sole fresh holdout. Do not infer missing minutes.
selection: Development only: highest median per-symbol mean net R among candidates with at least 5 trades per symbol. The low minimum allows slow rules to be examined, never establishes statistical confidence. Need at least 4/6 profitable development symbols. Already-observed 2024 and 2025 are diagnostics, not fresh validation. Only 2026 is a new holdout.
acceptance: Development-selected candidate only: >=4/6 profitable symbols, positive equal-sleeve return and mean net R, positive 95% seven-day block-bootstrap lower bound in fresh 2026 holdout; positive aggregate stress return. Require >=30 completed trades per symbol in fresh holdout to call the strategy sufficiently sampled. No tuning or further study if rejected. Two study-level selections are disclosed; each lower 2.5% tail is a conservative two-trial familywise protocol, not a deflated Sharpe calculation.
limitations: Six surviving liquid crypto perpetuals, not a point-in-time universe or six independent asset classes
Static conservative precision assumptions, not historical exchange filters
One-minute OHLC execution, no historical order book, liquidation or market impact
Independent equal-capital sleeves, no cross-margin portfolio simulator
Historical holdout is a research split, not prospective live evidence
